user_input: Continue the story from the line "Tifa leaned her head gently against the back of Cloud's neck. 'I missed you you know.'"
model_output:
Cloud smiled and wrapped his arms around Tifa. "I missed you too, Tifa. I'm so glad you're back and safe."

Tifa looked up at him and smiled. "I know, me too. I just want to make sure you're okay and that you're safe."

Cloud nodded and kissed her on the lips. "I'm okay, Tifa. I'm safe now that you're back. And I'm going to make sure you're always safe from now on."

Tifa smiled and kissed him back. "I trust you, Cloud. I know you'll always protect me."

Cloud kissed her again and wrapped his arms around her. "I love you, Tifa. I'll always be here for you."

Tifa smiled and kissed him again. "I love you too, Cloud. I'll always be here for you too."

They stood there, holding each other and kissing, as the sun began to rise over the city. They knew that they had to get up and get ready for the day, but they didn't want to leave each other's side.

"We should probably get up," Cloud said reluctantly.

"I know," Tifa replied. "But we can come back up here later."

Cloud nodded and kissed her one more time before they reluctantly left the rooftop and went back to their room. They knew that they had a lot to do today, but they also knew that they had each other, and that was all that mattered.
